# Test statement-level expression rewrite
ex {
	var s string
	println(s) -> println(s + "!")
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F() {
	println("hello")
	println("world")
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 package m

 func F() {
-	println("hello")
-	println("world")
+	println("hello" + "!")
+	println("world" + "!")
 }
